oneThing.title: The one thing
oneThing.body: Yesterday: no prior checks. Volatility is the only thing that moved and it moved down: VIX -1.14 pts, roughly 1.7x its own 20-session median, the widest single input on the board while the index sat still. This is a calm-tape regime — risk priced cheaper without the index having to rally. But the calm is a mask. Beneath a flat SPY sits a genuine unwind in the longest-duration corners of tech, and a still-hawkish 60% hike probability into 9/16 is exactly what punishes that duration first.
